newsitem.title: USA: Swift Transport files for share offering.
newsitem.headline: Swift Transport files for share offering.

text.p: Swift Transportation Co Inc said it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed offering of 3.5 million shares of common stock.
Swift said the company was offering 2.5 million of the shares and its president and chief executive officer, Jerry Moyes, was offering one million.
Underwriters, led by Salomon Brothers, have an over-allotment option of 525,000 additional shares.
Swift, a truckload carrier with terminals in six Western cities, said it planned to use proceeds from the offering to reduce debt and for general capital purposes.
